facts.content: Patient presents with a left-sided throbbing headache since midday.
facts.source_text: CC: Left-sided throbbing headache since midday

facts.content: The headache had a sudden onset.
The headache is associated with zigzag lines in vision.
facts.source_text: associated with zigzag lines in vision

facts.content: The headache is associated with blurred vision in both eyes.
The headache is associated with nausea.
The headache is associated with photophobia.
The patient has vomited twice with the current headache.
The patient reports a similar headache a few weeks ago that lasted a couple of days.
facts.source_text: similar headache few weeks ago, lasted couple of days

facts.content: There is no history of recent head trauma.
The patient has no prior history of migraines.
The patient has been taking Microgynon for three months for contraception.
The patient's mother has migraines.
The patient's mother has underactive thyroid.
facts.source_text: Mother has migraines and underactive thyroid

facts.content: The patient works in the fashion industry.
The patient reports high work stress.
The patient reports no depression.
The patient lives alone.
The patient does not smoke or drink alcohol.
The patient has no fever.
No skin rashes are present.
There is no speech difficulty.
There is no limb weakness or numbness.
There are no balance issues.
The primary assessment is suspected migraine.
Left-sided throbbing, photophobia, and nausea or vomiting are noted as features suggesting migraine.
facts.source_text: Left-sided throbbing, photophobia, nausea/vomiting suggest migraine

facts.content: Work-related stress is assessed as a problem.
Stress at work is noted as possibly contributing to the headache.
facts.source_text: Stress at work noted, may contribute to headache

facts.content: Patient is advised to use a headache diary to identify triggers.
facts.source_text: Recommend headache diary to identify triggers

facts.content: Patient is advised on using paracetamol, cocodamol, or NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or naproxen for headaches.
facts.source_text: Advise on using paracetamol, cocodamol, NSAIDs (ibuprofen/naproxen)

facts.content: Prophylactic migraine medications are to be considered if headaches persist.
facts.source_text: Consider prophylactic migraine meds if headaches persist

facts.content: The patient is instructed to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
